question: How many measures are prescribed for an image intended for worship by others?
premises: The image measure is the subject.
It is prescribed as to be made.
Two measures are specified for the purpose of others.
inference: An image for others should be made according to two prescribed measures.
uncertainties: The exact two measures are not named in this verse.
plain_english: The image measure should indeed be made in two measures when it is for the benefit of others.
